activity_summary: At Old Swan you stood with half the parish for a mayor who does not live among you. Gannet, on his oars, said the new man would pull down the playhouses by Christmas, that the old one was to be an earl, and that the Spaniard was in the Downs. A passenger asked to follow the barge and was told to follow in his own boat or swim. That is the line you kept. Kemp took his hat off toward Bishopsgate and bade the absent mayor sweeten. Mistress Ansell said Sir John went out as he came in, liking nobody, and that he kept his own door. You did not take his going for a victory. A woman's dark head was turned away, laughing, and you did not look long enough to know who stood beside her. You are Egeon at two.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused the three news, kept the one line, and did not name the woman.

entities.name: Davy Gannet
entities.context: Stayed on the oars, gave his news, and would not follow the barge.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Came for the drums and took his hat off toward Bishopsgate.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Saw the sword go first and said Sir John had kept his own door.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Kept her footing, and saw the woman at the edge.

entities.name: the lady of the parish
entities.context: Turned away, laughing. She did not speak, and she was not named.

entities.name: Sir John Spencer
entities.context: Stood at the back of his own company. He did not look at the stair, and he did not speak.

facets.activity: Kept the boatman's line at Old Swan

quotes.speaker: will_kemp
